patterns.note: Asymmetrical project showcase sections with a large title and device mockup on one side, and descriptive text with category tags on the other, creating a dynamic visual flow.
Expressive, custom-script-like display font used for key brand statements, contrasted with a clean, bold sans-serif for section headings and a legible sans-serif for body text.
Rich, warm, and earthy color palette with deep purples, mustard yellows, and teal accents, creating a distinctive bohemian-inspired aesthetic.
Content sections animate into view with a subtle fade-up and slight slide-in effect as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic reveal sequence.
Consistent project showcase sections featuring a large, bold project title, a device mockup displaying the work, and descriptive text with categorized tags.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations reveal content sections with a staggered fade and slight upward translation as they become visible, utilizing CSS keyframes for smooth transitions.
The main navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining brand presence and easy access to menu items throughout the user's journey.
Full-bleed hero sections use a fixed background image that creates a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls, enhancing depth and visual interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, expressive display headings (~4-5x body) with a bold, clean sans-serif for section titles (~2-3x body) and a legible sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) on interactive elements like buttons and cards, maintaining a soft but not overly playful feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing overall, with a slightly airy hero section and consistent vertical rhythm between content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its highly personalized, 'couple' brand identity, expressed through the hero image and the playful, expressive typography. It successfully integrates a warm, almost retro-bohemian aesthetic with a professional web design and development portfolio, creating a memorable and unique brand presence.
